recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2). 2. Add title at top-left: 'Adding' in bold red (#CC0000), 'Ridge' in bold blue (#0000FF), 'Regularizer to the model' in bold red, then a space and 'λ=3' with λ in blue and =3 in red; use a large sans-serif font (~36pt). 3. Add a yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle at the top-right with black text '17' (~14pt). 4. Create three horizontal rows below the title. For each row, place from left to right: a Train table, a blue arrow, a W box, a blue arrow, and a Test table. 5. Train table (all rows): red (#CC0000) border, 4 rows × 9 columns (first column for row labels). Header: X1 X2 X3 X4 X5 X6 X7 X8. Row X1: 1 2 3 4 8 9 10 11. Row X2: 1 3 5 6 16 7 5 3. Row y: 2 4 6 8 16 18 20 22. Add a small blue 'Train' label tab overlapping the top-left. 6. In row 2 only, change the last X1 cell to 30 and fill it yellow (#FFFF00). In row 3 only, change the last X1 cell to 60 and fill it yellow. 7. W box (all rows): red border, white fill. Inside, show a 3×1 column vector labeled W in bold red, then below it '||W||^2 = <value>' also in bold red. Row 1 values: 0.1, 1.95, 0.03 with norm 3.8. Row 2 values: 1.2, 0.72, 0.77 with norm 2.45. Row 3 values: 1.77, 0.32, 0.99 with norm 4.2. 8. Test table (all rows): red border, 4 rows × 4 columns. Header: Test1 Test2 Test3. Row X1: 30 40 50. Row X2: 15 20 25. Row y varies by row: row 1 = 59, 78.7, 98.4; row 2 = 34.1, 45.1, 56.1; row 3 = 26.2, 34.4, 42.5. Add a small blue 'Test' label tab overlapping the top-left. 9. Draw blue (#0000FF) right-pointing arrows between Train→W and W→Test in each row. 10. Ensure all table text is black (#000000) and smaller than the title; keep row labels (X1, X2, y) bold.
